title: Daily routines and free time
vocabulary: Sports, hobbies, days of the week, time
function: Talk about what you do every day

sections.heading: What is the Present Simple?
sections.body: The Present Simple is used to talk about habits, routines and things that are always true. We use it for actions that happen regularly: every day, on Mondays, always, never.

sections.heading: Spelling rules for he / she / it
list: Most verbs add -s: work → works, play → plays
Verbs ending in -ch, -sh, -s, -x add -es: watch → watches, wash → washes, go → goes, fix → fixes
Verbs ending in consonant + y change to -ies: study → studies, fly → flies

sections.heading: Negative
sections.body: Use do not / does not + base verb.
list: I do not like coffee. (I don't like coffee.)
She does not eat meat. (She doesn't eat meat.)
They do not work on Sundays.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: Use Do / Does + subject + base verb.
list: Do you play football?
Does he work here?
Do they live in London?

sections.heading: Adverbs of frequency
sections.body: They show how often something happens. Position: before the main verb, after the verb 'to be'.

sections.heading: Time expressions
list: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at midnight
in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening
on Monday, on Saturdays
every day, once a week, twice a month

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Do not say 'She play tennis'. Say 'She plays tennis'.
Do not say 'I no like'. Say 'I do not like'.
Do not say 'I always am happy'. Say 'I am always happy'.

list: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
at the weekend (Saturday + Sunday)

phases.name: Discovery
phases.intro: Look at these sentences. Read them carefully and think about the questions below.
sentences: I wake up at 7 every day.
He watches TV in the evening.
We do not go to school on Sunday.
My father always reads the newspaper.
questions: In sentences 1, 2 and 3, what happens to the verb with 'she' and 'he'?
In sentence 4, how do we make a negative?
In sentence 5, how do we make a question?
In sentences 6 and 7, where does the adverb of frequency go?
In sentence 8, what is the adverb and where is it?

questions.explanation: With 'they' we use the base form: go.

questions.prompt: My brother ___ a bike to school.

questions.explanation: After 'to be' the adverb comes after. 'Never' fits here.
Before a main verb, the adverb comes before the verb.

phases.name: Free practice
prompts: Write 5 sentences about your daily routine. Use the Present Simple. Include what time you wake up, have breakfast, go to school/work, have dinner and go to bed.
Write 5 sentences about your free time. Include activities you do and the days of the week.
Write a short paragraph (5 sentences) about a family member's routine. Use at least 3 adverbs of frequency.

questions.prompt: My sister ___ to music every day.

questions.explanation: With 'we' the negative is 'do not watch'.
All are valid adverbs. 'Never' is the strongest.

questions.prompt: ___ you meet your friends at the weekend?

questions.explanation: The adverb 'always' goes before the main verb.

sections.heading: Key rules
list: Present Simple for habits and routines.
Add -s or -es with he / she / it.
Negative: do not / does not + base verb.
Questions: Do / Does + subject + base verb?
Adverbs of frequency: before the main verb, after 'to be'.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Forgetting the -s with he / she / it.
Using 'do' with 'to be'.
Placing adverbs before 'to be' instead of after.

sections.heading: Useful phrases
list: I wake up at...
I usually...
I never...
She always...
Do you...?
Does he...?
Every day, once a week, twice a month.
